title: Highlights of Thailand | A Luxurious Delight
highlights: Enjoy a luxurious vacation in the Land of Smiles, Thailand, and have some experiences as you explore its famous cities like Bangkok and Pattaya.
Spend time watching the Alcazar Cabaret Show, where talented artists show dance and theatrical acts, creating a spectacle of lights and music.
Enjoy an evening on the Chao Phraya Cruise and savour delicious Thai cuisine as you sail past the city's landmarks, like the Grand Palace and Wat Arun.
See a wide range of exotic animals like tigers, giraffes, and zebras roam freely in their natural habitat as you visit the wonderful Safari World Park.
overview:
About the Tour: 
Bangkok, the capital city of Thailand is a place known for its vibrant and exciting atmosphere and holds rich history and culture. The land of glittering shrines and dynamic street life, known to locals as Krung Thep, the ‘City of Angels’. Whether you enjoy spending your time in Bangkok visiting the renowned temples of Wat Pho or Wat Phra Kaew, strolling along the small paths in Chinatown, savoring the flavors of exceptional Thai cuisines, or haggling in the Chatuchak Weekend Market, this place has it all.
On the other hand, Pattaya is a city that comes out alive in the night. It is known as a carefree party town where people seek endless rollicking good times. From luxurious beach cafes to bustling street markets, from diving into the blue sea to dancing till the dawn in the town’s hottest party spot, Pattaya has all the ingredients for the perfect luxurious vacation.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok
days.desc: Welcome to the City of Angels, Bangkok! Upon your arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel. After reaching the hotel, you can relax for the day or spend the day exploring some of the famous places in the city like the Floating Market Bangkok, ﻿Siam Park City, among others. Afterwards, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Safari World | Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise Experience
days.desc: Begin your day with an exciting adventure at Safari World, Bangkok's premier animal park. Get transferred from the hotel to the Safari World and enjoy close-up encounters with exotic animals during the safari drive and captivating marine life shows. After that, get transferred to Asiatique The Riverfront, to board your Chao Phraya Cruise and admire the beauty of Bangkok's skyline as you sail along the shores. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Pattaya | Alcazar Cabaret Show
days.desc: Check out from your Bangkok hotel and enjoy a scenic drive to Pattaya. Upon arrival, check in to your Pattaya hotel and spend some time at leisure, exploring nearby attractions or relaxing by the beach. In the evening, prepare for an unforgettable experience at the Alcazar Show. Known for its dazzling performances, the Alcazar Show features elaborate costumes, impressive stage designs, and talented performers. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Pattaya.

days.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
days.desc: Start your day with a thrilling adventure to Coral Island (Koh Larn). Depart from Pattaya by speedboat and arrive at this tropical paradise known for its clear turquoise waters and sandy beaches. Spend the day engaging in various water activities such as snorkeling, parasailing, and jet-skiing, or simply relax and soak up the sun. After a day of fun and relaxation, return to Pattaya by speedboat.
